newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis confident Germany to meet euro criteria.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis confident Germany to meet euro criteria.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday he was confident in Germany's ability to be ready for European monetary union at the start of 1999.

"I don't doubt the German authorities' ability to meet their objectives and that Germany will be ready to move to the single currency from January 1, 1999. I have no doubts on this," he told reporters as he left a cabinet meeting.
Asked if Germany would meet the criterion of a public deficit limited to three percent of gross domestic product, he replied: "Yes. Three percent, absolutely."
Pressed by reporters to specify whether he meant "three percent" or a more specific "3.0 percent", he replied: "Yes. it's three-zero, absolutely." -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
